notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Hi again! We've made a few small changes for this last update:

[h1]New[/h1]
It hasn't gone unnoticed that our players have enjoyed trying to speedrun the game and competing for the fastest runs. To encourage this even more, we have now added a visible timer. It will be even easier now to keep track of how much time you spend playing, without having to open the tab screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381339/228ba9b182c9697f8f583c4048391335c60244aa.png[/img]

[u][h2]Update[/h2][/u]
We also made a few small improvements:
[list]
[*] [b]Tutorial[/b]: As requested by some of our players, the tutorial now is a bit more elaborate than it was before.
[*] [b]Cursor[/b]: Small detail, but we also replaced our boring old cursor with a nicer looking one. 
[/list]
Thank you for [i][b]3,000+ downloads![/b][/i] We hope you continue enjoying ReSpaced and that this update makes it more accessible for new players.

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
[b]We're back with a new update![/b]

[h1]NEW[/h1]
Some of the pralls have shown rather... [i]explosive[/i] reactions to certain waste material we have not yet determined the origins of. They seem to lack the bursts of energy the regular pralls display when attacking, instead they've become quite unstable and have show explosive reactions to contact with other test-subject. Interestingly their shell have started to turn red as a side-effect, the relation to their explosive nature and this coloring has not yet been determined.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381339/314ca169ad2a80503acf93786d262173ba46b47a.png[/img]
[u][h2]Fixed[/h2][/u]
[h3]Dustine kill-aura[/h3]
Some people may have noticed that Dustine seems to attack so fast you couldn't even notice when you approach her too fast. After some investigating we came to the conclusion it was a reflex attack faster than one could see. We got her some therapy and now she normally sucks and smacks you with her duster.

[h3] Selline's lazy positioning[/h3]
We have noticed Selline wasn't very consistent in relocating her shop. After an official warning she now moves her shop around every time the player ventures through the space station.

[h3]Bolliver's sliding curse[/h3]
Whenever the player uses Bolliver a [i]bit[/i] too much, he seems to curse the player leaving them sliding around the room at increasing speeds. After a thorough exorcism this should no longer happen.

[b]We hope this update and especially the new enemy will give our players an improved experience! [/b]

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[b]Thank you all for playing our release version of ReSpaced! It's unfortunate that some of you encountered  bugs, but of course we have made a few changes to fix those![/b]

[h1]NEW[/h1]
[h3]Leaderboards[/h3]
Besides just fixes, we've also added [b]Leaderboards[/b]! Compete with all our players to get the best time, down to the millisecond. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381339/0e49541a2c08d5e84f43e7a8d3b14228706a5b40.jpg[/img]
[h3]Achievements[/h3]
With great speed comes great.. achievement?
With your runtimes now visible on the fancy new leaderboard, we also added some new milestones in the form of achievements. Let's see how fast you can beat this game!

[u][b][h2]Fixed[/h2][/b][/u]
Then there were some things we fixed, like:
[h3]LaserDrone laser accuracy[/h3]
Don't you hate it how that LaserDrone has been misleading you with pointing their laser the wrong direction? Well, we adjusted their coding and now they'll be properly aiming for your noggin!
[h3]Enemies spawning in crates[/h3]
Some of the enemies were too scared to face our players, so we upped their courage a bit and now they should no longer spawn in crates.
[h3]Meta-coins[/h3]
Selline must've gone colourblind, because these coins weren't looking right! After a fresh new spray-paint they now are the colours they should be. Now you can count your precious coin-parts without any mistakes and they'll be shown correctly on your status screen.

[u][b][h2]Updated[/h2][/b][/u]
Various improvements were also called for, for example:
[h3]Merchant hatch indicator[/h3]
Selline was getting a bit lonely being ignored by all the players and added a fancy new sign to her shop entrance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381339/96e5e4e4d2ffcc40e7847dcc796cc7fca25b703a.jpg[/img]
[h3]Health Upgrade balancing[/h3]
Not many people were purchasing Selline's max-health upgrade, so she decided to make it more worth your scraps. She adjusted some values to the health upgrades, to better support our players.


[i][b]Hopefully these improvements to our game will grant our players with a better and more fun gaming experience. We look forward to seeing your fastest runs![/b][/i]
